audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags this directly: 'level chart contradicts data: Milio wins 56.16% but the chart gives Brand 6/7 stages vs 1.' phases[2/3/4/5].side all read 'Skill' while content.win[2-5] read 'Brand' and packet.levelChart agrees (Brand x6, Milio x1). phases[6].side reads 'Skill' while win[6] reads 'Milio'.
audit.why: Four of seven rows show the full-layer chart disagreeing with the content-layer chart and the packet ground truth — a reader sees 'even' where the actual matchup and the surrounding prose (whys[2-5], early, mid) all describe Brand dominating.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[2/3/4/5].side to Brand and phases[6].side to Milio to match win[]/packet, rewriting phases[2/3/4/5].why (previously generic Milio-favorable template text) to ground the Brand-favor verdict in his actual poke/burst kit and the level-6 Pyroclasm bounce; phases[6].why already described a Milio-favorable late game so was left as-is.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says Brand's poke is 'out-damaging your Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) heal in every trade.' Milio's Q has no heal — it's a knockback/slow ball; the sustain ability is his W (the empowering zone that heals allies).
audit.why: Same fabricated-mechanic pattern seen elsewhere in this slice: crediting Q with a function it doesn't have.
audit.corrected: Changed 'your Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) heal' to 'your W zone heal', without inventing an unconfirmed ability name for W.
sources: ownerKit Q/W ability text in brief

audit.why: Needs a real, punishable cooldown number.
audit.corrected: Added Sear's real cooldown (8s rank 1, 6s maxed).
